subject: Fallback: solo-scheduler stitch for Opteron demo
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>

Cc: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick note on your Redwood demo — missed slot

Hi Samira —

We noticed you weren't able to make the walkthrough you booked this morning. Totally understand — time zones and calendars conspire. If it's easiest, you can pick a fresh 20-minute slot on my team's solo-scheduler here: https://cal.redwood.ai/solo/Samira-Reschedule-OP2385 (two clicks, confirms immediately).

If you'd prefer someone to stitch the short tour together (very quick: AE + SE, 15–20 minutes) we can do a concierge fallback — I can loop in Markus or Vanessa and set a tight window that works for you.

Optional attachments: concierge_playbook.md (brief internal checklist we use when customers ask for a stitched, high-signal mini-demo).

What would you prefer? Happy to hold a couple of spots next week.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
SDR, Redwood Inference
priyom@redwood.ai

From: Samira Patel <samira@opteronhealth.com>

Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick note on your Redwood demo — missed slot

Hi Priyom —

Sorry about that — I misread the timezone on my calendar invite (that was on me). I definitely want to see Redwood in action; we're evaluating tight on cost and latency, so a short, focused session would be perfect.

Available windows for me (PT):
- Fri Oct 8, 09:30–10:30
- Mon Oct 11, 08:00–11:00

If you can book something in a 20-minute window that hits one of those slots, great. I'm fine with the solo-scheduler link if that's easiest. Also looping in our Sales Ops in case they need to approve a PO or confirm attendees.

Also attaching a short doc with our product priorities / what we want to validate: Opteron_MVP_requirements.pdf — should help the demo focus.

Best,
Samira Patel
Product Lead, Integrations
Opteron Health

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Quick note on your Redwood demo — missed slot

Hi Samira —

Thanks for the note and for sending the requirements doc, that helps a lot. Two fast options so we can move this to calendar: 

1) Solo 20-minute walkthrough (recommended if you want a quick look): use this link and pick any 20-min slot that matches the windows you listed — https://cal.redwood.ai/solo/Samira-Reschedule-OP2385

2) Concierge stitch (AE + SE, 20 minutes): we can book a focused tailor-made walk where we'll cover integration points and a short latency/cost sketch. Proposed slots (PT):
- Fri Oct 8 — 09:40–10:00
- Mon Oct 11 — 08:30–08:50

If you pick the concierge option we'll prep a 1-page pre-demo checklist so Vanessa (SE) and I can hit the three validation points from your doc. I've attached a short pre-demo checklist for transparency: pre-demo-checklist.pdf.

If handy, pick via the solo link and I'll convert to a concierge booking on our side and add the SE notes.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.ai

If Samira uses the solo link, let's make sure we convert it into a concierge stitch if the booking duration >= 20m and the Opteron_MVP_requirements.pdf indicates integration work.
